apps.name: Soccer Stats
apps.subtitle: Track goals, assists, and match stats
apps.localizedDescription: Track your player’s goals, assists, and match stats across seasons, and score games live from the sideline.

versions.localizedDescription:
- The Stats tab is now your player's career page: totals and goals per game,
  milestones, a by-season table (with their number and the team's record),
  goals & assists by season, and their best game. Pick a season to zoom in
- Milestones: every 10 career goals and assists, first goal for each team,
  hat tricks, and scoring streaks of 3+ games
- Season Stats tab: a results strip (tap a game) and goals & assists by game
  bars replace the line chart
- Game recap: a shareable picture of a game (score, result, your player's
  goals and assists, photo and milestones). Opens after Done on the live
  screen, and from Share recap on any played game
- Head-to-head: upcoming games show your last results against that opponent
  (any season), or "First meeting"
- Friendlies don't count toward any stats (career totals, milestones, best
  game, charts, season totals, head-to-head); they still show in the Events
  list and can be shared as a recap

- Game reminders (iPhone app): a notification an hour before each game with a
  kickoff time. Turn on from the Seasons ⋮ menu; tap one to open the season
- Add upcoming games to calendar: on a season's Events tab. The iPhone app
  adds them straight to your calendar; the website downloads a calendar file
- Full backup and restore: Seasons ⋮ menu → Download full backup saves
  everything (including photos, team numbers and play-by-play); Restore from
  backup puts it back. The Excel export is still there for reading
- An "Offline" note shows when there's no connection, so you know changes are
  saved and will sync
- On a computer, the app stays a centered column instead of stretching across
  the screen

- Season standings: each season's record (W / L / D and points) shows on the
  Seasons list and under the team name inside the season
- The season's Stats tab has a Standings table (played, won, drawn, lost,
  goals for/against, goal difference, points) and recent form
- Counts played games with a score, 3 points a win and 1 a draw; friendlies
  are left out, and a game logged for two of your players counts once

- Live scoring: once anything is recorded, a blank score counts as 0, so a
  game with no goals ends 0–0 (and goals count up from 0–0)
- Tapping Done on the live screen with nothing recorded asks whether to save
  the game as a 0–0 result
- Results with only one side's score filled in show the other side as 0

- Events tab results show the final score with a W / L / D badge, plus your
  player's goals and assists
- Upcoming games show date, time and home/away, then the location on its own
  line, with Log stats and Live buttons underneath; away games read "at …"
- Removed the Live button from past games, the goal/assist +/− buttons, and
  the duplicate button from the cards (Duplicate match is inside each game)
- Fixed: on iPhone, the date and kickoff fields in the match form (and the
  schedule import) spilled past their space and ran into other fields
